features.label: Went blind running a library
features.detail: Became director of the national library as his sight failed. The irony was not lost on him.

features.label: Reviewed books that do not exist
features.detail: Invented entire literatures and then footnoted them. Fiction disguised as scholarship.

features.label: Never wrote a novel
features.detail: Argued it was wasteful padding. Everything essential is under twenty pages.
